Flex Design System is the design system for the Qualys marketing website (qualys.com): product pages, resources, events, blog and global navigation. It gives designers, developers and stakeholders one shared set of foundations, components and rules. The live Flex site, [flex-design-system.pages.dev](https://flex-design-system.pages.dev), is the reference that every design and build is checked against.

## Principles and design language

The design language reinforces the brand promise: **reliable, calm, confident, trustworthy, warm and approachable**. Every element, from color to motion, turns those values into interface decisions.

### Color

![A bar in three parts: Qualys Blue for calm takes 30% of the width, White and Warm Off White for clear 60%, Qualys Red for confident 10%.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Calm (blue), clear (white), confident (red).** Soft blues and off-whites are the base, for tranquility and clarity. Red is used sparingly: it marks the primary call to action and high-stakes moments (alerts, warnings), never decoration. The brand reads as calm and focused, not reactive or aggressive. In short: Qualys Blue and Qualys Red on warm off-white grounds, with charcoal for text and dark sections. As a guide to balance: about 60% clear, 30% calm and 10% confident.

### Typography

![Two type specimens side by side: Wix Madefor Text in bold for headings and UI, IBM Plex Sans in regular for body copy.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Dependable, reliable, stable.** A balanced type scale with generous line heights for easy reading. No loud styles; every weight has a purpose. Type feels confident without being heavy-handed, so complex content stays approachable. In short: Wix Madefor Text for headings and UI, IBM Plex Sans for body copy.

### Spacing

![Seven blue bars showing steps of the spacing scale: 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 48 and 100 pixels.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Confident, clear.** Consistent spacing guides the eye and gives the page room to breathe. It sets hierarchy and predictability, which makes pages easier to scan. Negative space reinforces a sense of control and calm.

### Components

![A sample of components: a primary button, a secondary button, a text link, a text field, a badge, a toggle and a checkbox, each with a clear label.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Trusted, focused.** Modular, sturdy and unobtrusive. Clear labels, predictable behavior and subtle affordances. No decorative overload: components quietly do their job with precision.

### Shape

![A card holding a tinted box, an input, a checkbox and a badge, beside the five corner radii: 16px cards and modals, 12px buttons and nested boxes, 10px inputs and menus, 6px badges, 4px checkboxes.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Rounded corners that get smaller as elements nest; soft shadows, used after surface color and strokes.

### Motion

![Three bars comparing durations: color changes 150ms, buttons, inputs and cards 200ms, menus, tabs and larger moves 300ms.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Quiet and short (150–300ms, ease-in-out). Nothing bounces, and only a modal scales, slightly, as it opens.

### Voice

![A sample of copy with notes: the heading Detect, Prioritize, and Eliminate Risk is in Title Case; the sentence speaks to your team in the second person; the buttons Get a Demo and Learn More start with a verb.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Second person, Title Case headings, calls to action that start with a verb.

## Governance

The live Flex site ([flex-design-system.pages.dev](https://flex-design-system.pages.dev)) is the source of truth for how the Qualys website is designed and built.

- **Design here first.** New pages and changes are designed with Flex's components and tokens before they go to development. Developers build from Flex, not from one-off mockups.
- **What's published is what to build.** Everything on the site is approved to build. New ideas and experiments stay as drafts in Claude until they are checked and published, so nothing half-finished reaches the site.
- **The site mirrors this design system.** The site is generated from the same files (tokens, guides, component READMEs and previews). Nobody edits the site by hand: change the design system, then publish.
- **Add back anything built outside it.** If a page on qualys.com uses something Flex doesn't have, add it here (as a new component, a variant or a documented exception) so the next person finds it.
- **Known problems are written down.** If a component has a problem that isn't fixed yet, it is described under Notes in that component's README, so designers and developers see it before they use it.

## Collaboration

- **Designers:** start from Flex components and the Example page. Work that needs something new goes into Flex first, then into page designs.
- **Developers:** build from the component READMEs and `index.d.ts`. If the live site differs from Flex, Flex is right: update the page, or report the difference so it can be fixed here.
- **Content writers:** follow the Content guide; component READMEs give each part's character limits.
- **Reviewers and stakeholders:** review in the Example page and on component cards; leave feedback on the design system as comments.

## Contribution and support

How to get access, work with Claude, make and publish a change, and bring a new collaborator up to speed is in **Change Management**, under Start. For questions, ask in the Qualys Design System project in Claude.

## Guidelines

The detailed rules follow this overview, one section each. Read the section for what you are building before using a token or component.

- **Content** (`guide-1-content.md`): voice, casing, CTAs, numbers, dates and times.
- **Color** (`guide-2-color.md`): which token goes where.
- **Typography** (`guide-3-typography.md`): families, the type scale and weights.
- **Layout, Spacing and Radius** (`guide-4-layout.md`): breakpoints, margins, columns, spacing, radius and elevation.
- **States and Motion** (`guide-5-states-motion.md`): hover, focus, disabled and timing.
- **Icons and Logos** (`guide-6-icons-logos.md`): the icon sets, sizes and colors, the Icon component and its library, the Qualys logo and other companies' logos, with the icon and logo files.
- **Media** (`guide-9-media.md`): photography, video, product images and people photos, with the image files.
- **Buttons and Links** (`guide-8-buttons-links.md`): button tiers and their labels, do's and don'ts, mobile sizing, inline hyperlinks and text link buttons.
- **Choosing Components** (`guide-11-choosing-components.md`): which component or page module to use for each job, including which form to use where.
- **Change Management** (`guide-10-change-management.md`): getting access, working with Claude, making and publishing a change, and onboarding.
